Senses.Explanation: The jeweled lotus seat of the Chan records: the hall's high seat — inherited with dread from the old sharpeners, defended as more than patter, granted to the patron's birthday, and staging a buddha's whole display. Hanxiu Ruqian points his staff at the seat: the great jeweled lotus seat, held by the old sharpeners topsy-turvy, plunged them living into the unbroken hell — and now he, dragged by debts of office he cannot push off, joins the line tossing sand upon it, Guxue Zhenzhe lets his imagined one-track man complain that the jeweled lotus seat should carry some Chan, some Way, some mystery — not worldly patter like child's play — and answers him with the yellow-faced master's own rule that the world's talk and livelihood never opposed the true face, Jie'an Jin rules that every old sharpener on the jeweled lotus seat made clever into clumsy there, so today, unable to hold back, he files the case by the record, and Qiran Chaozhi has the great patron's birthday bring the mountain monk onto the jeweled lotus seat for the great buddha-work — settling everyone's doubting mind, lighting each one's hidden nature, opening the inherent power and the right-eye. Zhulang Chesheng is summoned by the grand guardian's feast onto the jeweled lotus seat to raise the one thing and repay the boundless debt, closing with the verse — without the heaven-shore unicorn colt, how would the fragrance flow for a hundred ages, Zhanran Yuancheng on Amitabha's birthday stages the buddha descending on his whisk-tip, seated on the vajra jeweled lotus seat, the crown-light shining on worlds beyond count, Chuiwan Guangzhen, in his bridge-repair inscription, sets the road-leveling sage who won the prediction entering the jeweled lotus seat — a sage of perfect penetration whose merit passes reckoning — and Xiuye Minglin is asked how, before he has even mounted the jeweled lotus seat, the sweet dew already moistens all beings, answering that the eyes of gods and men are opened wide and the old face forgotten.
